analysis.title: Vistra Corp. (VST): First Take: 3Q EBITDA beat vs. GSe/Street; updated guidance reflects solid FCF conversion
key_insights: VST reported 3Q26 ongoing adjusted EBITDA of $2,378 mn ($2,360 mn including the Asset Closure segment) against GSe of $2,150 mn and FactSet consensus of $2,142 mn.
Segment results beat GS estimates everywhere except Retail. Texas was $1,227 mn vs GSe $1,073 mn (+$154 mn), East $979 mn vs $959 mn, West $76 mn vs $49 mn. Retail was $98 mn vs $118 mn (-$20 mn).

The consolidated EBITDA beat came mostly from higher revenues (operating revenues $6,282 mn vs GSe $5,305 mn) and lower interest expense ($254 mn vs $297 mn). Higher fuel and purchased power costs ($2,963 mn vs $2,250 mn) and higher D&A ($711 mn vs $454 mn) partly offset it.

Adjusted net income was $915 mn vs GSe $962 mn, and operating income was $1,447 mn vs $1,494 mn, so the EBITDA beat did not carry through to earnings. GAAP EBITDA was $2,585 mn, including a $559 mn adjustment for unrealized hedging losses.
2026 ongoing adjusted EBITDA guidance was narrowed to $7.1-$7.5 bn from $6.8-$7.6 bn, with a higher midpoint. GSe is $7.3 bn.
2026 ongoing adjusted FCFbG (free cash flow before growth) guidance was narrowed and raised to $4.3-$4.7 bn from $3.9-$4.7 bn. GSe is $3.6 bn, so the guidance sits above GS's forecast.

2027 guidance was initiated at $7.7-$8.5 bn ongoing adjusted EBITDA and $4.3-$5.1 bn adjusted FCFbG, against GSe of $7.9 bn and $4.2 bn. It reflects the recently closed Cogentrix acquisition and the first phase of the Meta operating PPA. Cogentrix is not yet in GS numbers.
About $2.5 bn of share repurchase authorization is available through year-end 2028. Hedging levels rose to 98% for 2027 and 78% for 2028, from 94% and 72%.
GS expects the call to focus on Texas data center demand after the election results, PJM regulatory developments and customer demand, DOE nuclear uprate financing, and 2027 guidance.

Questions GS plans to raise: how the Texas election changes data center demand and talks with the incoming administration, capex deployment against the $4.2 bn uprate commitment, and whether growth capital should shift into buybacks at current valuation.
GS rates VST Buy with a 12-month price target of $200, based on 10.0x EV/EBITDA and a 7.0% FCF yield. The price was $112.89 at the 5 Nov close, implying 77.2% upside.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q EBITDA beat GS and Street, and 2026 FCFbG guidance of $4.3-$4.7 bn is above GSe of $3.6 bn. GS is encouraged by the execution and raised expectations.

earnings_insights: VST 3Q26 ongoing adjusted EBITDA reported at $2,378 mn ($2,360 mn including Asset Closure) vs GSe $2,150 mn and FactSet consensus est $2,142 mn.
3Q26 adjusted net income reported $915 mn vs GSe $962 mn. Adjusted net income post minority interest and preferred dividends was $867 mn vs GSe $917 mn.
2026 ongoing adjusted EBITDA guidance narrowed to $7.1-$7.5 bn from $6.8-$7.6 bn (GSe $7.3 bn). 2026 adjusted FCFbG guidance raised to $4.3-$4.7 bn from $3.9-$4.7 bn (GSe $3.6 bn).
Initial 2027 guidance: ongoing adjusted EBITDA $7.7-$8.5 bn (GSe $7.9 bn) and adjusted FCFbG $4.3-$5.1 bn (GSe $4.2 bn). It includes Cogentrix and the first phase of the Meta operating PPA.
GS forecasts EPS of $8.20 for 2026E, $9.40 for 2027E and $12.00 for 2028E, and EBITDA of $7,330 mn, $7,924 mn and $8,891 mn. GS's 3Q26E EPS is $2.72.
risk_factors: Future of the power demand theme.
Texas data center demand could shift after the election results, with the incoming administration's stance unclear.
